comment: The draft recognises that continuous central connectivity cannot be assumed, but intermittent connectivity and unreliable electricity should be treated as core architectural conditions in low-resource and rural settings, not only as considerations supporting federated exchange.

anchor.note: p.32 l.240–255 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The draft recognises that continuous central connectivity cannot be assumed, but intermittent connectivity and unreliable electricity should be treated as core architectural conditions in low-resource and rural settings, not only as considerations supporting federated exchange.
public.suggestedRevision: Add minimum offline-first requirements covering local data capture, encrypted storage, delayed synchronisation, conflict resolution, audit continuity, identity matching after reconnection, safe device recovery, alternative power arrangements and continuity of essential services during extended outages.
